description: Read the owner's OMRON blood pressure readings, syncing with OMRON connect first. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, taken in each reading's own time zone; the default is the 30 days ending today, at most 366 days. `user` picks one cuff user slot (1 or 2). Returns readings newest first (date, local time with seconds, utc_offset, systolic and diastolic in mmHg, pulse in bpm, irregular_heartbeat, body_movement, cuff_wrap_ok, device, user) and a summary with the count and the average, min and max. A note says when the sync failed or is still running and the readings come from the cache.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (default today in the owner's timezone)

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (default 29 days before end_date)

user.description: Cuff user slot, such as 1 or 2 (default both)

name: omron_get_blood_pressure
